result.title: GPUMAP: GPU-Accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection
result.summary: Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings. To address this limitation, we present GPU-accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (GPUMAP), an efficient progressive DR algorithm designed for interactive use. We identify three atomic operations within UMAP and restructure them into a progressive pipeline. As part of this adaptation, we introduce modifications to UMAP, including operation queues, instance-wise local join, and scheduling strategies. We further accelerate computation by leveraging GPU parallelism, enabling interactive analysis of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware. Finally, we employ our implementation to systematically study the behavior of progressive DR, investigating how projections evolve over time relative to the ground-truth projection and how biased data streams influence the quality and stability of the resulting projections.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GPUMAP，将 UMAP 拆解为三个原子操作并重构为渐进式降维流水线，配合操作队列、实例级 local join 与调度策略及 GPU 并行，实现百万规模数据的交互式分析，并系统考察渐进投影随时间的演化与数据流偏差的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其渐进式、可流式更新的投影机制可能为在线观察 LVR 内部 latent 状态几何与相似度结构的演化提供工具线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理，需核查其增量更新是否适用于 latent 轨迹分析。
